checklist: Does the project use its own appropriate visual direction rather than a reused palette?
Is there a clear primary purpose for the screen?
Is the main CTA obvious within 2 seconds?
Are clickable and passive elements visually distinct?
Are status tags, filters, and actions using separate visual classes?
Is complexity hidden behind progressive disclosure?
Are there unnecessary containers or nested cards?
Does desktop avoid stretched mobile layout?
Does mobile avoid hidden primary actions?
Does bottom navigation avoid content collision?
Does the result feel premium, not prototype/AI slop?
